release.title: Electronic card transactions: September 2026
release.headline: The value of electronic card spending in retail industries decreased 0.4 percent ($30 million) in September 2026, compared with August 2026.

executive_summary.text: Seasonally adjusted retail card spending decreased 0.4% in September 2026 (NZD 6,976.0 million, down NZD 30.0 million from August 2026).
Seasonally adjusted core retail card spending decreased 0.7% in September 2026 (NZD 6,264.0 million, down NZD 41.2 million from August 2026).
Seasonally adjusted total electronic card spending decreased 0.5% in September 2026 (NZD 9,682.7 million, down NZD 51.5 million from August 2026).
Seasonally adjusted monthly card spending rose most in Fuel (+2.9%) and fell most in Hospitality (-2.3%) in September 2026.
Unadjusted (actual) card spending totalled $9.19 billion across 166.8 million transactions in September 2026, with a mean transaction value of $55.1.
Retail card spending increased 0.1% in the September 2026 quarter (seasonally adjusted), compared with the June 2026 quarter.
Core retail card spending increased 0.4% in the September 2026 quarter (seasonally adjusted), compared with the June 2026 quarter.

context.text: Seasonally adjusted retail card spending was NZD 6,976.0 million in September 2026. The 288 monthly observations captured range from NZD 2,145.0 million to NZD 7,089.4 million; these nominal values include price changes.
Retail card spending trend was NZD 7,000.2 million in September 2026, down 0.2% from August 2026.

previous_comparison.note: Vintages are the official data files published with each Stats NZ release: 2 stored, earliest Electronic card transactions: August 2026. Revisions before that release cannot be observed.

revisions.note: Vintages are the official data files published with each Stats NZ release: 2 stored, earliest Electronic card transactions: August 2026. Revisions before that release cannot be observed.

corrections.note: No earlier distinct statistical capture is stored for this publication.

definitions: ECT covers New Zealand-based electronic card transactions supplied by participating providers; it is not all retail sales or all household consumption. Unclassified transactions are excluded and provider coverage and merchant classifications can change.
Spending is nominal NZD, not adjusted for inflation. Values are expressed in NZD millions; counts are transactions and mean transaction values are NZD.
Actual means unadjusted. Seasonally adjusted series remove seasonal/calendar effects; trend series smooth short-term movements. Seasonal and trend estimates can be revised.

Retail includes consumables, durables, hospitality, apparel, motor vehicles excluding fuel, and fuel. Core retail excludes motor vehicles and fuel. Total ECT also includes services and non-retail excluding services.
notes: Seasonally adjusted components are independently adjusted and may not sum to aggregates. Composition charts use actual industry levels without stacking overlapping aggregates.
Quarterly observations are the official ECTQ source series, never sums of adjusted months. Quarterly changes compare the previous quarter, not the previous month.
Historical observations in one download are one publication vintage. Revision history covers only distinct publications or corrections actually captured by this monitor.
Official CSV levels are rounded to 0.1 million; movements can differ from published headlines by source rounding. R (revised) statuses are shown as unknown, not final; all estimates may change.

series.caveat: Spending is nominal NZD, not adjusted for inflation. Values are expressed in NZD millions; counts are transactions and mean transaction values are NZD. Actual means unadjusted. Seasonally adjusted series remove seasonal/calendar effects; trend series smooth short-term movements. Seasonal and trend estimates can be revised.
